## Interpretation rules used

- A `success` conclusion was not accepted without scanning jobs, required steps, annotations, and all available log text.
- Generic keyword matches from test names, negative fixtures, `0 vulnerabilities`, or normal bucket progress were excluded.
- A retry/flaky marker is an abnormal run even if the final conclusion is success.
- Provider retry recovery is recorded separately from a skipped object or degraded parity.
- Production audit failures are separate from informational full development-tree summaries.
- Expired logs are recorded as unavailable, never inferred or described as fully audited.
